scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']){try{fs.rmSync(f,{force:true})}catch{}}const isPnpm=/pnpm/.test(process.env.npm_execpath||'')||/pnpm\//.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'');if(!isPnpm){console.error('Use pnpm instead');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('artifacts/fiaba/dist/public','dist/public',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('artifacts/fiaba/dist/public','public',{recursive:true});"
